segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Observe changes to the playback rate asynchronously. private func observeRateChanges() async { let name = AVPlayer.rateDidChangeNotification for await notification in NotificationCenter.default.notifications(named: name) { guard let reason = notification.userInfo?[AVPlayer.rateDidChangeReasonKey] as? AVPlayer.RateDidChangeReason else { continue } switch reason { case .appBackgrounded: // The app transitioned to the background. case .audioSessionInterrupted: // The system interrupts the app’s audio session. case .setRateCalled: // The app set the player’s rate. case .setRateFailed: // An attempt to change the player’s rate failed. default: break } } } ```
